caption: This shoyu ramen features an amber-brown, glossy broth with floating noodles and green onions. In a white ceramic bowl with a subtly textured rim, dark green nori, caramelized chashu pork, and golden-brown menma bamboo shoots are served on a dark wooden table with visible grain.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections near the bowl's edge.
The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with a caramelized, glossy surface and visible fat marbling.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough surface with visible veins.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear as golden-brown, slightly translucent, elongated pieces with a fibrous, textured surface.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, subtly textured rim.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved bowl shape.
